name: Better Stack
description: Uptime monitoring, log management and on-call alerting.

pricing.notes: Free tier: 10 monitors, 1 status page, 3GB logs (3-day retention). Paid usage is modular/add-on based — extra monitor capacity runs ~$25/mo per 50 monitors; treat this as approximate, not a full-bundle price. Checked 2026-08-07.
